cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Let Them Think They Won
cards.instruction: Protect someone’s confidence by hiding how much you softened the challenge, changed the terms, or withheld an advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Congratulations on winning the cake contest, Mum.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your cake isn't on the judging table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. It stayed in the kitchen where I can admire it privately.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still beat seven cakes that had every intention of winning.

mechanism: A coaches its mother to accept her cake victory while concealing withdrawal of A stronger entry.
confusable: Not openly gifting a win: A offers an unrelated kitchen excuse and directs Mum to successful technique rather than admitting the softened field.
comparison: Personal chess concession versus withholding contest entry.
